mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalPosts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUB') AS publishedPosts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'TEM') AS temporaryPosts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUB' AND NOT public_access) AS privatePosts, COALESCE(SUM(view_count) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUB'), 0) AS totalViews, COUNT(DISTINCT category_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUB') AS usedCategories, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUB') AS lastPublishedAt FROM tb_post

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_category) AS totalCategories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tag) AS totalTags, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) FROM tb_post_tag_map) AS usedTags, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_tag) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) FROM tb_post_tag_map) AS unusedTags, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_post_draft) AS draftCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_file WHERE NOT deleted) AS fileCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM tb_file WHERE NOT deleted) AS fileTotalSize

SELECT cat.name AS categoryName, COUNT(p.id) AS postCount FROM tb_post p INNER JOIN tb_category cat ON p.category_id = cat.id WHERE p.status = 'PUB' GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY postCount DESC, cat.name

SELECT t.name AS tagName, COUNT(m.post_id) AS postCount FROM tb_post_tag_map m INNER JOIN tb_tag t ON m.tag_id = t.id INNER JOIN tb_post p ON m.post_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'PUB' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY postCount DESC, t.name LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id AS id, p.subject AS subject, cat.name AS categoryName, p.view_count AS viewCount FROM tb_post p LEFT JOIN tb_category cat ON p.category_id = cat.id WHERE p.status = 'PUB' AND p.public_access = true ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE #{zoneId}) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS postCount FROM tb_post WHERE status = 'PUB' AND created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
